_about: Hand-written from today's code, never captured: what GET /subway/stations/<id>/arrivals answered in ko, en and zh at 00:20 and 02:00 KST on Wednesday 2026-10-21 (service day Tuesday 2026-10-20), timetable only, over the subway-topology characterization's seed (every arrival state 14 h old) and the committed timetables, generated 2026-10-20 at commit 46c6ea60, before the topology reader landed. Each answer keeps its status, Cache-Control, Vary, ETag and body; the body's bytes are JSON.stringify of it. Changed 2026-10-23 with the behavior it pins, no other value changed: each station gained its coords from revision 1 of subway-station-coords, and each ETag was recomputed from the new bytes. Changed 2026-10-24 with the behavior it pins (app ADR 0022, D4), no other value changed: each answer's meta gained serverNow, the clock at +09:00, each train gained isFirstTrain, from the earliest train of its direction at its platform in the instant's table, and each ETag was recomputed from the new bytes. Changed 2026-10-25 with the behavior it pins (ADR 0022, D2, D3), no other value changed: each train became the shared call plus its trainNo, in the call's key order: arrivalAt became scheduledArrivalAt, or scheduledDepartureAt at a train's origin, to the second at +09:00; each train gained the timetable departure at its platform, isLastRun and runId (<line>/2026-10-20/<trainNo>); source scheduled became basis timetable and status scheduled; destination, express and isFirstTrain became headsign, isExpress and isFirstRun; each line's generatedAt is at +09:00 to the second; and each ETag was recomputed from the new bytes.
